sub_questions.q: What is the AntiScam dataset in the paper?
sub_questions.answer: AntiScam is a corpus of human-human anti-scam dialogs created to learn human elicitation strategies, collected via a role-playing Amazon customer service scam scenario on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
sub_questions.quote: we created a corpus of human-human anti-scam dialogs in order to learn human elicitation strategies.

sub_questions.q: How many human-human dialogs does the AntiScam dataset contain?
sub_questions.answer: The AntiScam dataset contains 220 human-human dialogs.

sub_questions.q: How many AntiScam dialogs and sentences were manually annotated?
sub_questions.answer: A subset of 100 dialogs containing 3,044 sentences was annotated by two expert annotators.
sub_questions.quote: We recruited two expert annotators who have linguistic training to annotate 3,044 sentences in 100 dialogs

sub_questions.q: What are the average conversation length and average utterance length in AntiScam?
sub_questions.answer: The average conversation length is 12.45 turns, and the average utterance length is 11.13 words.
sub_questions.quote: The average conversation length is 12.45 turns and the average utterance length is 11.13 words.

sub_questions.q: How many AntiScam users successfully identified their partner as an attacker?
sub_questions.answer: 172 out of 220 users successfully identified their partner as an attacker.
